name: Anastasia Hartwell
summary: In the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Anastasia Hartwell trains Forsaken and Horde mages in the arcane arts. She guides spellcasters in their studies and directs magical research and field work across Lordaeron and beyond.

sections.title: Arcane Mastery in the Ruins
sections.body: In the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Anastasia Hartwell teaches Forsaken and Horde mages to channel arcane energies. Though Lordaeron has fallen to ruin, former human practitioners such as Anastasia preserve their scholarly traditions in undeath. She demands discipline in the practice of magic. Careless incantations can consume the untrained.

sections.title: Field Research and Relics
sections.body: Anastasia sends promising students into the field as well as teaching them spells. At Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal Glades, mages gather snapdragons to learn how far the plague has spread. In the Apothecarium, they visit Algernon's alchemist shop to capture invisible creatures of pure magic behind a strange disturbance. Her assignments bring them face to face with magic's dangers, even within their own city.

sections.title: Allies of the Craft
sections.body: Anastasia's connections reach beyond Tirisfal. As Horde spellcasters grow more skilled, she coordinates with trainers in distant lands, including Deino in Orgrimmar. She also directs advanced students to solitary masters such as Tabetha in the swamplands of Dustwallow Marsh. Her guidance keeps Forsaken mages connected to the Horde's wider magical pursuits.

faq.answer: Anastasia Hartwell trains Forsaken mages in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. She teaches spells and assigns work retrieving arcane artifacts and reagents across Lordaeron.

faq.q: Where can I find Anastasia Hartwell?
faq.answer: You can find Anastasia Hartwell in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, among arcane practitioners and trainers beneath the city's vaulted subterranean ceilings.

faq.q: What does Anastasia say to non-mages?
faq.answer: Anastasia warns non-mage visitors to beware of magic on their travels. It readily burns the untrained.

faq.q: What quests does Anastasia Hartwell offer?
faq.answer: Anastasia gives mages training assignments, including gathering snapdragons at Balnir Farmstead and investigating a magical disturbance in an alchemist's shop in the Apothecarium. She also directs them to work with distant teachers such as Deino in Orgrimmar and Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Is Anastasia Hartwell related to other Hartwells in Tirisfal?
faq.answer: Anastasia shares a surname with Andrew Hartwell and Geoffrey Hartwell, but their family relationship is unconfirmed.

faq.q: Why does Anastasia send mages to the Balnir Farmstead?
faq.answer: Anastasia asks mages to gather Balnir Snapdragons to measure the plague's spread in Tirisfal Glades and send the flowers to the apothecaries.

angles.text: As a mage, you can learn higher spell ranks from Anastasia Hartwell in the Undercity. She mentors Horde mages passing through and gives them important assignments.
As an undead, you see the arcane traditions of Dalaran and Lordaeron carried on among the Forsaken, despite the tragedy of undeath.
As a member of the Horde, you can see Anastasia connect Lordaeron's arcane heritage with the Horde's wider magical work through trainers such as Deino in Orgrimmar.
